package.name: ral_interfaces
package.description:
The message and service vocabulary shared by the scenario runner (Phase 3), the fault manager (Phase 4) and the operator dashboard (Phase 6). It is a separate package because all three must agree on the same definitions, and because a state string that only one of them spells correctly fails silently: the dashboard simply never matches it.
The semantics of every field - in particular which component is entitled to publish which FaultEvent state, and what each MissionState means - are written into the .msg files themselves, not only in prose elsewhere.
